$comment: Register of the lab's long-lived NON-ENTRA secrets (privileged-access standard: every remaining secret has an owner, an expiry and a rotation). Entra app credentials are inventoried live by 06-NHI-Inventory.ps1; this file covers what Graph cannot see. 06-NHI-Inventory.ps1 -SecretsRegisterPath merges it and flags a missing owner, a missing or past expiry, and a missing rotation.

NEVER a value: 'store' names WHERE the secret lives (a Key Vault secret name, a GitHub Actions secret name, or a gitignored local file), never its content. status: present = the lab creates it today (local stack); planned = created at tenant time. owner is a ROLE, not a person, so a leaver never orphans an entry.
OWASP NHI Top 10 (2025) ids: NHI2 Secret Leakage, NHI7 Long-Lived Secrets, NHI1 Improper Offboarding. Nothing here has run against a tenant.

Dates are READ, never typed: createdOn comes from the store's own metadata (file birth time, Docker volume CreatedAt), and dateSource says which. expiresOn = createdOn + the rotation ceiling in 'rotation' (a due date, not a property of the secret). 'unknown (<reason>)' = no date can be read yet (a tenant-time secret, or a local stack not generated on the build machine); 06-NHI-Inventory.ps1 still flags it SECRET-NO-EXPIRY, with the reason. The present entries were read on the build laptop on 2026-10-20: a fresh local stack makes them stale, so re-read and update them in the same change.

secrets.name: aws-scim-token
secrets.system: AWS IAM Identity Center SCIM (modules/apps provisioning)
secrets.store: Key Vault secret aws-scim-token; passed as TF_VAR_aws_scim_credentials only inside the apply run
secrets.rotation: P365D (AWS SCIM access tokens are valid for one year - verify: on creation) and on any exposure

secrets.name: servicenow-provisioning-password
secrets.system: ServiceNow PDI integration user svc-entra-provisioning (Entra provisioning connector, modules/apps servicenow_provisioning.tf)
secrets.store: Key Vault secrets servicenow-provisioning-username / servicenow-provisioning-password; passed as TF_VAR_servicenow_provisioning_credentials only inside the local seeding apply (then in Terraform state, sensitive)
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: Key Vault attributes.created of servicenow-provisioning-password (2026-11-05T10:10:00Z), read 2026-11-05. expiresOn = createdOn + P180D (rotation ceiling).
secrets.rotation: P180D and on any exposure: reset the password in ServiceNow, update Key Vault, then terraform apply -replace='module.apps[0].azuread_synchronization_secret.servicenow[0]' with the seeding exports, then Test Connection

secrets.name: okta-clinic-idp-client-secret
secrets.system: Okta federation (Entra external IdP for the affiliated clinic)
secrets.store: Okta credential store (lab/terraform/okta, TF_VAR_entra_client_secret at apply time; the root's local state) and the Entra app okta-clinic-idp (modules/apps/okta.tf; minted by a human with output okta_idp_client_secret_command, max 180 days); no copy in the repo
secrets.rotation: P180D; revoked when the Okta IdP is retired (docs/okta-migration-runbook.md)

secrets.name: midpoint-reader-client-secret
secrets.system: midPoint Entra connector (app midpoint-reader) - registered exception E3, nhi-standard.md
secrets.rotation: P90D until migrated to a certificate (Set-AppGovernancePolicy.ps1 caps new secrets on existing apps at 90 days)

secrets.name: servicenow-integration-password
secrets.system: ServiceNow PDI integration user svc.sentinel (itil, web-service access only; notify + containment playbooks)
secrets.store: Key Vault secret servicenow-integration-password (read at deploy time by Deploy-Playbook.ps1 / Deploy-ContainmentPlaybook.ps1); the operator Keychain item contoso-lab-servicenow-sentinel is the copy it was written from
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: Key Vault secret servicenow-integration-password attributes.updated 2026-11-05T10:10:09Z (first version; the ServiceNow user svc.sentinel was created the same minute). expiresOn = createdOn + P90D (rotation rule). Read 2026-11-05.
secrets.rotation: P90D and after any playbook redeploy by a leaver

secrets.name: svc-soc-automation-signin
secrets.system: Entra cloud-only account svc-soc-automation (owns the Contoso SOC team; authorized the playbooks' Teams connections): password + authenticator-app seed
secrets.store: macOS login Keychain of the operator laptop: contoso-lab-svc-soc-automation (password), contoso-lab-totp-svc-soc-automation (TOTP seed). Never in Key Vault, the repo or CI
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: Entra createdDateTime of svc-soc-automation and its authenticator method (2026-11-05), the day both Keychain items were written. expiresOn = createdOn + P180D (rotation ceiling). Read 2026-11-05.
secrets.rotation: P180D, and at once if the operator laptop is lost: reset the password, re-run enroll.mjs --force, then authorize-teams-connection.mjs --force for both connections

secrets.name: dc01-dsrm-password
secrets.rotation: P180D and after every DSRM use

secrets.name: splunk-hec-token
secrets.system: Splunk second SIEM - HTTP Event Collector token (+ admin password)
secrets.createdOn: unknown (stack not generated: lab/splunk/.env absent on the build laptop, 2026-10-20)
secrets.expiresOn: unknown (stack not generated: lab/splunk/.env absent on the build laptop, 2026-10-20)
secrets.rotation: regenerated with the stack; P90D if the trial is kept running

secrets.name: pam-stack-database-and-admin-passwords
secrets.system: PAM stand-ins: Guacamole DB, Conjur DB + data key, midPoint DB + administrator
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: Docker volume CreatedAt of contoso-pam_guac-db, _conjur-db, _midpoint-db and _midpoint-home (all 2026-10-19T17:39:23-04:00); the DB passwords and the Conjur data key take effect at first volume init. lab/pam/.env's own timestamp is not used: pam-up.sh rewrites the file (set_env) on every run. expiresOn = createdOn + P180D (rotation ceiling). Read 2026-10-20.
secrets.rotation: regenerated by pam-up.sh after `pam-up.sh --cleanup`; at most P180D
secrets.note: Per laptop: dated from the build laptop's stack (dateSource). A fresh stack (pam-up.sh --cleanup, then pam-up.sh) regenerates the secret and makes these dates stale: re-read and update them in the same change.

secrets.name: vault-unseal-keys-and-root-token
secrets.system: Vault (PAM vault stand-in) unseal keys + initial root token
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: birth time of lab/pam/.secrets/vault-init.json (2026-10-19T17:39:38-04:00), written once by `vault operator init`; Docker volume contoso-pam_vault-data was created the same minute. expiresOn = createdOn + P180D (re-key ceiling). Read 2026-10-20.
secrets.rotation: root token revoked after bootstrap in production; unseal keys re-keyed (vault operator rekey) at most P180D
secrets.note: Per laptop: dated from the build laptop's stack (dateSource). A fresh stack (pam-up.sh --cleanup, then pam-up.sh) regenerates the secret and makes these dates stale: re-read and update them in the same change.

secrets.name: conjur-admin-api-key
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: lab/pam/.secrets/conjur-admin-api-key (birth 2026-10-19T19:19:28-04:00, last write 2026-10-19T19:19:35-04:00). expiresOn = createdOn + P180D (rotation ceiling). Read 2026-10-20.
secrets.rotation: rotate with `conjurctl role retrieve-key` / API key rotation at most P180D
secrets.note: Per laptop: dated from the build laptop's stack (dateSource). A fresh stack (pam-up.sh --cleanup, then pam-up.sh) regenerates the secret and makes these dates stale: re-read and update them in the same change.

secrets.name: guacadmin-password
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: birth time of lab/pam/.secrets/guacadmin-password (2026-10-19T17:39:40-04:00). expiresOn = createdOn + P180D (rotation ceiling). Read 2026-10-20.
secrets.rotation: set by pam-up.sh on every fresh stack; at most P180D
secrets.note: Per laptop: dated from the build laptop's stack (dateSource). A fresh stack (pam-up.sh --cleanup, then pam-up.sh) regenerates the secret and makes these dates stale: re-read and update them in the same change.

secrets.name: itsm-password
secrets.system: ITSM (ServiceNow Table API mock) user for check-out ticket validation
secrets.store: lab/pam/.secrets/itsm-password (gitignored); the PDI user's password at tenant time
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: birth time of lab/pam/.secrets/itsm-password (2026-10-20T03:30:16-04:00). expiresOn = createdOn + P90D, the only period in the rotation rule (the mock has none of its own). Read 2026-10-20.
secrets.rotation: mock: per stack; PDI integration user: P90D
secrets.note: Per laptop: dated from the build laptop's stack (dateSource). A fresh stack (pam-up.sh --cleanup, then pam-up.sh) regenerates the secret and makes these dates stale: re-read and update them in the same change.

secrets.name: adm-labops-password
secrets.system: Entra user adm-labops@ContosoHealthLab.onmicrosoft.com (Lab Operations automation admin account, ADR 0025): the first factor of its sign-in
secrets.store: macOS login Keychain item contoso-lab-pw-adm-labops (account = UPN) on the admin Mac; never in the repo, a log or argv
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: Keychain cdat of contoso-lab-pw-adm-labops (2026-11-05T10:18:00Z), read 2026-11-05. expiresOn = createdOn + P180D (rotation ceiling = the account's PIM eligibility, which also expires 2027-05-04).
secrets.rotation: P180D (with the eligibility renewal) and on any exposure: the operator cannot reset passwords, and because the account is an eligible member of a role-assignable group only a Privileged Authentication Administrator (or Global Administrator) may reset it (Learn, PIM for Groups) - reset into the same Keychain item, or recreate the account and re-run lab/scripts/demo/signin/enroll.mjs (staff sign-in toolkit, PR #131)
secrets.note: Holds no Entra role and no standing access; its only right is ELIGIBILITY for PIM-AWS-Lab-Admins (2-hour activation). Disabling the account is the kill switch for this AWS admin path.

secrets.name: adm-labops-totp-seed
secrets.system: Entra user adm-labops: authenticator-app (software OATH) seed - its MFA factor for sign-in and for the PIM activation
secrets.store: macOS login Keychain item contoso-lab-totp-adm-labops (account = UPN), written over stdin by lab/scripts/demo/signin/enroll.mjs
secrets.dateSource: createdOn: Keychain cdat of contoso-lab-totp-adm-labops (2026-11-05T10:22:02Z), read 2026-11-05. expiresOn = createdOn + P180D, aligned with the password and the eligibility.
secrets.rotation: P180D and on any exposure: lab/scripts/demo/signin/enroll.mjs --force (staff sign-in toolkit, PR #131) replaces the authenticator-app method (old seed useless once its method is deleted). Not phishing-resistant: ADR 0025 revisit trigger replaces it with a headless phishing-resistant method
secrets.note: Same Keychain as the operator's certificate key (ADR 0024): whoever holds the unlocked Mac holds both - ADR 0025 residual risk.
